complexity.notes: Correct but uses O(n) extra space; Floyd's tortoise-and-hare algorithm would detect the cycle in O(1) space. The unused counter `i` should be removed. Worst case degrades to O(n^2) under adversarial hash collisions on the node objects.
complexity.summary: Traverses the list while storing each visited node in a hash set; if a node is encountered that is already in the set, a cycle exists, otherwise the walk ends at null.
